title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. 2023-1386 located at 11200 West Dona Lola Drive, southerly of Wrightview…
text:
[Council File 26-1658; CD 4]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. 2023-1386 located at 11200 West Dona Lola Drive, southerly of Wrightview Place.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2023-1386, located at 11200 West Dona Lola Drive, southerly of Wrightview Place and accompanying Subdivision Improvement Agreement and Contract with security documents.
Owner: Rubikon LLC; Surveyor: W.R. Benson
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that the subdivider has paid a fee of $9,064.00 for the processing of this final parcel map pursuant to Section 19.02(B)(3) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. No additional City funds are needed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
